subject: Literature
title: Emily St. John Mandel's Station Eleven
description: A micro-lesson that makes Emily St. John Mandel's Station Eleven usable.

hook.text: Station Eleven is a pandemic novel that became a bestseller — and then a real pandemic made it eerily prophetic.

buildup.text: A flu pandemic kills 99 percent of humanity, and survivors form a traveling theater troupe performing Shakespeare.

discovery.text: The troupe's motto is 'survival is insufficient,' arguing that art and beauty are essential, not luxuries.

twist.text: Published in 2014, the novel surged in sales during COVID-19 as readers recognized their own world in its pages.

climax.text: Station Eleven reimagined dystopia as not just warning but elegy, mourning everything civilization would lose.

punchline.text: A fictional pandemic prepared readers for a real one.

quiz.question: What is the Traveling Symphony's motto in Station Eleven?
options: Art saves us when nothing else can
